titolo: Auto nuova a rate: quanto costa DAVVERO in 5 anni?
protagonista: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man, short dark brown hair, light stubble, wearing a navy polo shirt and jeans, middle-class look

copertina.sfondo: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt, shocked face standing next to a brand new compact city car in a middle-class Italian street, bold dramatic lighting

scene.voce: Marco compra un'utilitaria nuova. Venticinquemila euro, a rate. Sembra un affare. Ma quanto costa davvero?
sfondi: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, standing in an Italian car dealership next to a new compact city car with a price tag on the windshield

Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, standing thoughtful in the dealership with a hand on his chin, looking at the price tag of the new compact car

scene.voce: In cinque anni paga ventisettemilaseicento euro tra rate e interessi. Tremilacinquecento di assicurazione. Quattromilaottocento di benzina. Duemilaquattrocento di tagliandi. Millecento di bollo. E milleseicento tra parcheggi e pedaggi. Totale: quarantunmila euro.
sfondi: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, signing papers at an Italian insurance agency desk, his new compact city car visible through the window
Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, refueling his new compact city car at an Italian gas station, looking at the pump display
Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, in an Italian auto repair workshop talking to a mechanic next to his compact city car on a lift

scene.voce: Ma l'auto perde valore. Oggi ne vale venticinquemila. Dopo cinque anni, solo undicimila.
sfondi: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, proudly standing next to his shiny brand new compact city car in front of an Italian apartment building

Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, standing next to his same compact city car now five years older, dusty with small scratches, in front of the same Italian apartment building

scene.voce: Facciamo i conti. Hai pagato quarantunmila euro. Rivendi a undicimila. Il costo vero è trentamila euro. Cioè cinquecento euro al mese. Sedici euro al giorno, anche se non la usi.
sfondi: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, sitting at a kitchen table in an Italian home with a calculator, receipts and a notebook
Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, with a stunned wide-eyed face looking at the calculator display at the kitchen table
Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, holding an empty wallet next to a wall calendar in his Italian living room, worried expression

scene.voce: Come spendere meno? Compra un'auto usata di due anni. Confronta almeno cinque assicurazioni. E tieni l'auto più a lungo.
sfondi: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, looking happily at a two-year-old used compact city car in an Italian used car lot
Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, comparing insurance quotes on a laptop at his Italian living room table, smiling
Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, washing his older but well-kept compact city car in front of his Italian apartment building, content

scene.voce: Nella prossima puntata: quanto costa davvero un cane?
sfondi: Marco, 38-year-old Italian man with short dark brown hair and stubble, navy polo shirt and jeans, smiling in an Italian park while petting a friendly golden retriever puppy on a leash
